defects: BOTH: TMR 134.2 harmonization overclaim. The full paragraph (verified) shows Smith explicitly REJECTING the 'faith Christ Himself exercised' reading ('we think that it cannot refer to a particular degree or kind of faith which the Saviour exercised...') and concluding the faith of Jesus = 'the precepts and doctrines of our Lord.' Draft A's gloss 'the two pioneer senses and the Scripture sense are one faith seen from three sides' and Draft B's 'the two witnesses agree, for the faith that saves amply and fully is the very faith Jesus authored and lived' both present the harmonization as if Smith shares it. The ground-truth uncertainties note says the faith-BY-which-He-overcame sense is the section's own Bible-spine development that harmonizes EGW and Smith — it must be framed as the section's Scripture-grounded synthesis (Rev. 3:21; Heb. 12:2; Gal. 2:20), not attributed to Smith. Synthesizer: keep Smith only for what he actually says (distinct-from-the-commandments, kept-alongside-them, the gospel half) and let Scripture carry the overcoming-faith sense.

DRAFT A: defines a third owned symbol 'the testimony of Jesus = the spirit of prophecy' in Symbols-defined-here. The verified symbolDefs assign this section exactly two symbols (the third angel's message; the faith of Jesus). Rev. 19:10 belongs in the body as Scripture self-interpreting (both drafts have it), but elevating it to an owned symbol deviates from the verified section contract and risks colliding with symbol ownership elsewhere. Drop the third symbol entry; keep the body bullet.

DRAFT A: AJB 301.1 is filed under the Rev. 12:17 remnant/dragon block, but the Bates paragraph is about the three angels' messages and the third angel's presentation of the commandments and faith of Jesus — Draft B's placement (under the third-angel section, as the movement's historical anchor) matches the quote's content. Also, A's gloss 'EGW's 1888-era word' for 1SM 372.2 is loose — the statement is RH April 1, 1890 (the verified paragraph carries the date); say 1890 or '1888/1890 era' per the historyAnchor.

DRAFT A: minor Bible-first blemish — the 17LtMs witness is interleaved between Rev. 14:6 and Rev. 14:7 in the opening block, splitting the verse pair; B's ordering (both verses, then the EGW confirmation, then Rom. 1:16-17) is cleaner.

DRAFT B: discussion Q3 sets 'fear' against 'the patience of the saints' as alternatives, but Rev. 14:7 COMMANDS 'Fear God' — as worded it risks pitting the angel's own call against the message's fruit. Reword to distinguish the reverent fear of God the message commands from the terror of judgment the gospel removes.

DRAFT B: structural nit — the remnant block (Rev. 12:17/19:10) is inserted between Rev. 14:12 and the faith-of-Jesus development, so 'the faith of Jesus' is used and inline-defined before its own section unpacks it. Draft A's late-section flow (Rev. 14:12 -> righteousness by faith -> the faith OF Jesus -> works by love -> remnant -> Rev. 22:14) develops the symbol before deploying it and ends on the city; prefer A's ordering. B also cites 'Complete Victory' twice in near-identical glosses (Rev. 3:21 and 1 John 5:4 bullets) — keep one.

DRAFT B: gives Rev. 22:14 only as a bullet inside the faith-keeps-commandments block; Draft A's dedicated closing block ('The book closes as chapter 14 described') lands the arc better and matches the ground-truth gloss ('the book closes as chapter 14 described'). Either works, but don't lose the closing-benediction framing.

BOTH (accepted, not a fix): 17LtMs Lt 183 par. 4 strictly says the everlasting gospel is the subject of the FIRST angel's message; both drafts extend it to all three judgment-hour messages. The extension is fair (the letter's pars. 4-11 treat all three messages as one proclamation, and the ground-truth gloss makes the same move), but the synthesizer should keep the quote attributed to the first angel's message as both drafts correctly do.
bestOf: Use Draft B as the base for its contract fidelity and section-front-half, and graft Draft A's back-half ordering. Keep from B: (1) the two-symbol Symbols-defined-here block exactly as B has it — it matches the verified symbolDefs (A's third 'testimony of Jesus' symbol must be dropped to a body bullet); (2) the opening block that integrates Rom. 1:16-17 with Rev. 14:6-7 (gospel = power, righteousness by faith) before the judgment-call block; (3) AJB 301.1 placed in the third-angel section with the 'most solemn warning against false worship' clause (B quotes the exact verified words); (4) B's inline symbol definitions under Rev. 14:9 and 14:12 with the embedded verse snippets; (5) B's cross-links to 'The Second Adam — The Nature Christ Took' (Rev. 3:21 bullet and the carried 'second Adam / sinful flesh' symbol) — A lacks this thread entirely; (6) B's definition-paragraph chiasm 'the commandments show what the faith of Jesus produces, and the faith of Jesus supplies what the commandments demand'; (7) B's discussion Q2 (trying harder vs trusting fuller). Keep from A: (1) the late-section ORDER — faith of Jesus -> that-faith-works-by-love (1 John 5:3-4; John 14:15) -> remnant (Rev. 12:17/19:10 with TMR 114.1) -> dedicated Rev. 22:14 closing block — so the symbol is developed before the remnant deploys it and the section ends on the city; (2) A's fuller CIHS 167.1 quotation ('The result of an acceptance of these messages is given in the word...'), which carries the messages-END-in-a-people spine explicitly; (3) A's fuller TMR 127.1 quote including 'given in the period of the patience of the saints'; (4) A's 'Born of Water and of the Spirit' cross-ref on 1 John 5:4 (obedience in the born-again); (5) A's carried symbol 'sin as the consented transgression' -> 'What Sin Is'; (6) A's discussion Q3 (present truth / courtroom in session) in place of B's fear-vs-patience Q3; (7) A's fuller 3SM 172.3 quotation including 'Jesus becoming our sin-bearer that He might become our sin-pardoning Saviour.' In BOTH, rewrite the TMR 134.2 gloss so the harmonization of Smith's precepts-and-doctrines sense, EGW's ability-to-save sense, and the Scripture overcoming-faith sense is presented as the section's Bible-spine synthesis, not as Smith's own position — Smith's verified paragraph explicitly rejects the exercised-faith reading.
